verdict.rationale: Telemetry and usage-tracking opt-out is a fair question for a SaaS document API with an SDK and CLI, but nothing in the evidence documents a telemetry setting, opt-out flag, or usage-tracking control. On-prem and air-gapped Enterprise deployment and BAA/DPA terms are adjacent privacy features, not a documented telemetry opt-out, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
